name: Retold Fortune discards a Spell to draw a card
notes: Retold Fortune's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Expel the Departed (a SPELL-subtype ACTION card) is seeded into hand alongside it as discard fuel. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid. Because the discard-fuel card is itself a legal fast response, it first shows up as an option in the generic EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window; both players decline that (P1 PASS, then P2 PASS) before Retold Fortune's own MZMAYCHOOSE decision offers it as the card to discard. Discarding it draws a card.

rulesClauses: Discard up to one Spell card. If you do, draw a card.
